scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @archimesh/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @archimesh/server --filter @archimesh/web dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @archimesh/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @archimesh/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test
